entities.summary: Thomas Evert Petri is an American attorney and politician who was the U.S. representative for Wisconsin's 6th congressional district from 1979 to 2015; he is a member of the Republican Party. Tom Petri was a legal figures from Marinette (b. 1940-05-28, Marinette). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
